title: MajorTOM Burst
description: ELLIOT-Pretrain is a multi-modal Earth Observation dataset for pre-training AI foundation models, built on the MajorTOM global 10 km grid. It provides co-registered 10.56 km tiles across four sensors (Sentinel-2 L1C, Landsat 8/9 OLI-TIRS, Copernicus DEM GLO-30, ESA WorldCover) in three temporal regimes: monotemporal (250k tiles), monthly time series (12.5k × 12 timesteps), and burst/rapid-event (16.7k × 6 timesteps at ~5-day cadence). Tile locations were selected via hierarchical spherical k-means clustering to maximise global environmental diversity.

providers.name: Image and Signal Processing Group (ISP), Universitat de Valencia

readme: ## README.md # Major TOM ELLIOT-Pretrain [![Source Cooperative](https://img.shields.io/badge/Source_Cooperative-elliot--pretrain-blue)](https://source.coop/major-tom/elliot-pretrain) [![TACO v3](https://img.shields.io/badge/format-TACO_v3-green)](https://github.com/asterisk-labs/taco/blob/main/spec/main.md) [![Open In Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1_hJWZ9rvBcIIrG5zHD1xsz11LZIJfwxB) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-CC--BY--SA--4.0-orange)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) ELLIOT-Pretrain is a Major TOM expansion focused on **fast pre-training** of multi-modal AI foundation models on Earth Observation data. * Built on the original [MajorTOM](https://github.com/ESA-PhiLab/Major-TOM) global 10 km grid * 10.56 km tiles with harmonised 10 m resolution across all sensors for fast access * Four co-registered modalities in every tile, optical, thermal, elevation, and land cover * Three sub-datasets covering complementary temporal regimes Tile locations were selected using hierarchical spherical k-means clustering over [AlphaEarth Foundation](https://huggingface.co/Major-TOM/AlphaEarth-Foundations) embeddings to maximise global environmental diversity. The dataset follows the [TACO v3 specification](https://github.com/asterisk-labs/taco/blob/main/spec/main.md). ## Sub-datasets | Part | Name | Tiles | Timesteps | Cadence | Purpose | |------|------|-------|-----------|---------|---------| | A | Monotemporal | 250,000 | 1 | n/a | Global coverage, spatial diversity | | B | Monthly | 12,500 | 12 | monthly | Seasonal dynamics, phenology | | C | Burst | 16,666 | 6 | ~5-day | Rapid events, floods, fires, landslides | All three parts share the same four sensors. | Modality | Source | Resolution | Bands | |----------|--------|------------|-------| | Sentinel-2 L1C | ESA Copernicus | 10 m | 13 spectral | | Landsat 8/9 OLI-TIRS | USGS | 30 m | 11 (9 OLI + 2 TIRS) | | Copernicus DEM GLO-30 | ESA / TanDEM-X | 30 m | 1 (elevation) | | ESA WorldCover | ESA | 10 m | 1 (land cover class) | ## Quick Start Pick a tile index from Part A (monotemporal) and visualize all four modalities. ```python import numpy as np import rasterio import matplotlib.pyplot as plt BASE = "https://data.source.coop/major-tom/elliot-pretrain" IDX = 42 # change this to explore different tiles MODS = ["s2", "l8", "dem", "lc"] fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 4, figsize=(20, 5)) for j, mod in enumerate(MODS): url = f"/vsicurl/{BASE}/monotemporal/DATA/{IDX}/{mod}/data.tif" with rasterio.open(url) as src: if mod in ("s2", "l8"): rgb = src.read([4, 3, 2]).astype(np.float32) axes[j].imshow(np.clip(rgb / 3000, 0, 1).transpose(1, 2, 0)) elif mod == "dem": axes[j].imshow(src.read(1), cmap="terrain") else: axes[j].imshow(src.read(1), cmap="tab20") axes[j].set_title(mod) axes[j].axis("off") plt.tight_layout() plt.show() ``` ## Reproducible Example Full notebook covering all three parts, metadata queries with filtering, and a streaming PyTorch DataLoader with parallel fetching. **[Open in Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1_hJWZ9rvBcIIrG5zHD1xsz11LZIJfwxB)** ## Dataset Structure ``` elliot-pretrain/ ├── monotemporal/ # Part A, 250k tiles, 1 timestep │ ├── COLLECTION.json │ ├── METADATA/ │ │ ├── collection.parquet │ │ ├── sample__s2.parquet │ │ ├── sample__l8.parquet │ │ ├── sample__dem.parquet │ │ └── sample__lc.parquet │ └── DATA/{tile_id}/ │ ├── s2/data.tif │ ├── l8/data.tif │ ├── dem/data.tif │ └── lc/data.tif ├── monthly/ # Part B, 12.5k tiles, 12 timesteps │ ├── COLLECTION.json │ ├── METADATA/ # same 5 parquet files │ └── DATA/{tile_id}/ │ ├── s2/img_00.tif ... img_11.tif │ ├── l8/img_00.tif ... img_11.tif │ ├── dem/main.tif │ └── lc/main.tif └── burst/ # Part C, 16.7k tiles, 6 timesteps (~5-day) ├── COLLECTION.json ├── METADATA/ # same 5 parquet files └── DATA/{tile_id}/ ├── s2/img_00.tif ... img_05.tif ├── l8/img_00.tif ... img_05.tif ├── dem/main.tif └── lc/main.tif ``` Join key across metadata files is `internal:parent_id`, which points back to `internal:current_id` in `collection.parquet`. ## Citation ```bibtex @inproceedings{francis2024majortom, title={Major TOM: Expandable Datasets for Earth Observation}, author={Francis, Alistair and Czerkawski, Mikolaj}, booktitle={IGARSS 2024}, pages={2935--2940}, year={2024}, doi={10.1109/IGARSS53475.2024.10640760} } ``` ## License CC-BY-SA-4.0 ## Acknowledgements ELLIOT-Pretrain has been made possible thanks to [Asterisk Labs](https://asterisk.coop), the [ELLIOT](https://elliot-earth.eu) project (European Commission, Horizon Europe, Grant 101214398), and the [Image and Signal Processing Group (ISP)](https://isp.uv.es) at Universitat de Valencia.
